methodology: Each company/category was separately attempted October 31 through official website retrieval, official issuer-index searches, or regulatory filings. checked_at is audit finalization time, not individual HTTP retrieval time. Verified means primary-source content was reviewed, not that every dynamically rendered archive was exhaustively enumerated. Inaccessible or insufficient archives remain incomplete. The prior day's statuses are retained only for comparison, not silently inherited.
